name: Miyabidou Renmaru
source:
High school student. Myuu’s childhood friend. He’s usually cool-headed, but becomes hotblooded during emergencies. A quick thinker. After the incident at Integral, he and Myuu get lost in a world where time has stopped.

[Spoiler]Renmaru's Ego is transported into World A, while his Sublime remains in World R, receives amnesia, and is mistaken as "Inose Omega."

He is voiced by Takahashi Naozumi.[/spoiler]
